title: Report plan
description: What the renderer draws. The planner (LLM) writes the choices and the prose; code fills the facts: schema, signals, shape, masthead, arms, show_arms_key, full_results, the flag's discloses, weakens and survives, the options columns, each chart reference's key, each answer's warning, and each chart's level, unit and domain (marked 'Code-filled'). The planner writes in two calls, a structure (every choice) and its prose (flat {key, text} pairs), and code assembles them (threetears.evals.analysis.plan_assembly). Prose uses figure keys like {reading.<arm>.change|pts}, never typed numbers. No field is null: an optional part is a list of at most one, an optional scalar an empty string. See GENERATOR.md §2 and §6.2. The package's models (threetears.evals.kernel.report_plan) are held to this file by a test.

signals.description: Code-filled. GENERATOR.md §1, read off the report input as a lookup.

shape.description: Code-filled: the §1 lookup over the signals.

arms.description: Code-filled. Display names are the report input's (declared, never the planner's); the renderer resolves them with armLabels().

color_slot.description: -1 = the control (ink gray); 0.. = series colors in fixed order

headline_kind.description: What the headline is; must agree with mode (decide: decision, tradeoff: trade, no_call: no_call).

headline.description: The decision as an instruction with its reason; in tradeoff mode, the trade.

flag.description: The flag, or none. It carries no confidence: the decision does (decision.confidence). It holds no_rule in a tradeoff with no declared ranking rule and, only under a low confidence, report-wide caveats no confidence clause carries.

discloses.description: no_rule (a tradeoff with no declared ranking rule), or a report-wide caveat's id that no confidence clause carries (only under a low confidence): late:<criterion>, late:<criterion>:<name>, judge_uncalibrated, confound:<id in caveats.confounds>, apparatus:<dimension>, short_run:<run id>

caveats.description: The ids of the caveats the slot states beside the claim they qualify.

confidence.description: How sure the decision is. high: no open report-wide caveat remains. high_if_immaterial: the evidence is strong, and every open report-wide caveat is listed with its clause. low: the evidence is weak even if every caveat is immaterial. A caveat code proved immaterial is never listed: code renders its checked line. GENERATOR.md §2.5.

material_if.description: The clause the page prints: what the caveat is, and what would make it material.

option.description: an arm id, or a modeled option id

items.description: Code-filled: a column family, one of pass_rate, reading.change, reading.verdict, judged:<dim>, gate, measure:<key>, cost_per_1k (GENERATOR.md §2 item 6); any other is refused when the plan is generated

headline.description: A finding with subject and direction.

takeaway.description: One or two sentences on how to read the chart; empty for none.

caveats.description: The ids of the caveats the section states beside its finding.

title.description: what the control sets, as its label reads

binds.description: criterion it replaces: margin, floor:<id>, p95, price_per_point, weighting, lever:<factor>

default.description: a slider's start; a segmented control or select starts on its first option, a toggle off

recomputes.description: What the controls recompute and the page states, e.g. reading per arm + flip point

caveats.description: The ids of the method-level caveats (apparatus, latency, unreported) it states.

durable_claims.description: Claims about the subject for later campaigns' prior insights; code reads the runs each rests on from its keys.

answers.description: One per warning code raised on the recommended arm: a floor it broke, an aspect another arm is shown ahead of it on (a choice), an absolute bar it missed.

name.description: floor_broken and floor_unclear: the floor key; behind_on: the arm id shown ahead; bar_missed: the bar's measure key

title.description: Empty when the section headline says it.

query.description: What the chart reads from the report input. An empty list or string is no filter; limit 0 is no limit.

small_multiples_by.description: What the chart repeats its panel by; other than none only on a kind the kit panels (bars, diverging_bars, scatter_frontier, gate_scatter, dot_interval, heatmap, confusion)

reference.description: At most one reference line, at a declared line: a margin on a forest, a floor or budget at the criterion that reads the chart's one measure (GENERATOR.md §5.2). The planner picks the kind and code fills the key; the renderer reads its value from the key and writes its label.

key.description: Code-filled: a figure key, aspect.margin or aspects.<id>.margin for a margin, criteria.<id>.threshold for a floor or budget

emphasis.description: the one arm or row bolded or ringed, by id; empty for none

level.description: Code-filled: the interval level printed on the chart, e.g. 95% or 99.69%; empty without intervals.

domain.description: Code-filled: [low, high], or empty for the renderer to fit.
